cases.Test Case Title: Landing page loads branding, features, testimonials, stats

2. Observe hero/branding section, feature grid, testimonials and stats blocks.

2. Scroll to pricing/plan section.
3. Inspect the plan cards rendered (name, price, feature bullets).

2. Reload '/'.
3. Observe pricing section.
cases.Expected Result: UI shows fallback marketing copy for plans instead of a blank section or crash.

cases.Test Case Title: Navigate to Login from landing page
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. On '/', click the 'Log in' CTA in the header/hero.
cases.Expected Result: Browser routes to '/login'.

cases.Test Case Title: Navigate to Sign up from landing page
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. On '/', click 'Sign up' CTA.
cases.Expected Result: Browser routes to '/login' with the Sign up tab pre-selected.

cases.Test Case Title: Successful login with valid office credentials
cases.Preconditions: A seeded office user exists (e.g., owner@demo, password demo123).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Go to '/login'.
2. Enter valid work email and password.
3. Click 'Sign in'.
cases.Expected Result: Frontend POSTs to /api/auth/login; on 200 the tokens are stored, GET /api/auth/me is called, and the user is routed to '/admin' (or '/onboarding' if profile incomplete).

cases.Test Case Title: Show/hide password toggle
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Type a password into the password field.
2. Click the eye/show icon.
3. Click again to hide.
cases.Expected Result: Password text toggles between masked and plain visibility.

cases.Test Case Title: Remember email persists across sessions
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Log in successfully with 'Remember email' checked.
2. Log out.
3. Return to '/login'.
cases.Expected Result: Email field is pre-filled from fp_remember_email on next visit; password is not remembered.

cases.Test Case Title: Demo role chips prefill credentials (local/dev only)
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. On '/login', click the 'Super Admin' demo chip.
2. Repeat for 'Office' and 'Field Worker' chips.
cases.Expected Result: Each chip prefills the corresponding demo email into the email field.

cases.Test Case Title: Login fails with invalid password — generic error

2. Click 'Sign in'.

cases.Test Case Title: Login fails for non-existent email — same generic error
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Enter an email not registered in the system.
2. Enter any password.
3. Click 'Sign in'.
cases.Expected Result: Same generic error text as invalid-password case (no user enumeration).

cases.Test Case Title: API-down banner shown when backend is unreachable
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Block network access to the API host.

cases.Expected Result: UI shows a distinct 'cannot reach server' message rather than a generic credentials error.

cases.Test Case Title: Login routes Super Admin to /super-admin

cases.Expected Result: Post-login redirect lands on '/super-admin' dashboard.

cases.Test Case Title: Login routes field worker to /worker

cases.Expected Result: Post-login redirect lands on '/worker' dashboard.

cases.Test Case Title: Login routes office user with incomplete profile to /onboarding
cases.Preconditions: Office user whose company profile is incomplete.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Log in with such a user's credentials.
cases.Expected Result: Redirect goes to '/onboarding' instead of '/admin'.

cases.Test Case Title: Sign up creates user, Basic-plan company, owner membership, trial
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. On '/login', open the 'Sign up' tab.
2. Enter company name, work email, and an 8+ character password.
3. Submit the form.
cases.Expected Result: New user + company on Basic plan + owner membership are created; a 14-day trial (default) starts; a welcome notification is created; access/refresh tokens are issued and the user is logged in.

cases.Test Case Title: Sign up rejects password shorter than 8 characters
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open Sign up tab.
2. Enter a password of 6 characters.
3. Submit.
cases.Expected Result: Client-side (and server-side) validation blocks submission with a minimum-length message; no account is created.

cases.Test Case Title: Sign up rejects duplicate/already-registered email
cases.Preconditions: Email already exists in the system.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open Sign up tab.
2. Enter an email already used by another account.
3. Submit.
cases.Expected Result: Signup fails with a clear duplicate-account error; no second company/user is created.

cases.Test Case Title: Forgot password — generic success for existing and non-existing email
cases.Preconditions: Platform SMTP configured for one scenario, not required for the assertion itself.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. On '/login', click 'Forgot password'.
2. Submit a registered email.
3. Repeat with an unregistered email.
cases.Test Data: email A = registered, email B = unregistered
cases.Expected Result: Both submissions return the identical generic 'if an account exists, an email was sent' message (no enumeration).

cases.Test Case Title: Reset password with valid token succeeds
cases.Preconditions: A valid, unexpired reset token was generated via 'Forgot password'.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open the reset link '/reset-password?token=...' from the received email.
2. Enter a new password (8+ chars) and confirm it.
3. Submit.
cases.Expected Result: Password is updated; all existing refresh tokens for the user are revoked; success message shown; user redirected to '/login'.

cases.Test Case Title: Reset password rejects mismatched confirmation
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Enter new password and a different confirmation value.
2. Submit.
cases.Expected Result: Inline validation error shown; request is not submitted to the API.

cases.Test Case Title: Reset password rejects weak (<8 char) password
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Enter a 5-character password in both fields.
2. Submit.
cases.Expected Result: Validation error blocks submission.

cases.Test Case Title: Reset password rejects invalid/expired token
cases.Preconditions: Use an expired or already-used token, or a fabricated token string.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open '/reset-password?token=invalidtoken123'.
2. Enter a valid new password and submit.
cases.Expected Result: API returns an error; UI shows 'invalid or expired token'; password is not changed.

cases.Test Case Title: Previously issued sessions are logged out after reset
cases.Preconditions: User is logged in on Device A; performs reset from Device B.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. On Device B, complete a password reset for the user.
2. On Device A (still holding the old session), perform any authenticated action or wait for token refresh.
cases.Expected Result: Device A's refresh token is revoked; next silent refresh fails and the user is forced back to '/login'.

cases.Expected Result: User is created/updated, company_members row inserted, worker_profiles row created (default Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00 availability), seat cap re-checked, welcome notification sent, and office users with settings.users are notified of the join. User is logged in and routed to /worker.

cases.Test Case Title: Accepting invite that exceeds worker seat cap is blocked

cases.Test Case Title: Already-used invite token shows error

cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Click 'Manage billing' / 'Customer Portal'.
cases.Expected Result: Redirects to the Stripe-hosted Customer Portal for this company.

cases.Test Case Title: List SaaS invoices with hosted URLs
cases.Preconditions: Stripe invoices exist for the tenant.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Scroll to SaaS invoices list.
2. Click a hosted invoice link.
cases.Expected Result: Number, amount, status shown; link opens the Stripe-hosted invoice.

cases.Test Case Title: Trialing company receives correct Checkout trial days
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Start a Stripe Checkout upgrade while status=trial.
cases.Expected Result: Checkout session includes trial days consistent with the platform's configured trial_days.

cases.Test Case Title: Toggle email preferences and save
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Toggle 'assignments' off, 'customer invoices' on, 'subscription billing' off.
2. Save.
cases.Expected Result: Preferences persist on the membership and govern future platform-email delivery for this user.

cases.Test Case Title: View/edit own name, phone, avatar
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open '/admin/profile'.
2. Edit name/phone; upload avatar.
3. Save.
cases.Expected Result: Changes persist and reflect in the header/profile.

cases.Test Case Title: Change password from profile (if exposed)
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open change-password control.
2. Enter current + new password.
3. Submit.
cases.Expected Result: Password updates; user may be required to re-authenticate.

cases.Test Case Title: View role and company context
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Open profile.
cases.Expected Result: Current role and company name/context are displayed accurately.

cases.Test Case Title: List all notifications, mark one/all read, follow deep links
cases.Preconditions: Multiple unread notifications of different event types exist.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open '/admin/notifications'.
2. Mark a single item read.
3. Use 'Mark all read'.
4. Click a notification's deep link.
cases.Expected Result: List renders all notifications; read state updates correctly; deep link navigates to the correct entity (job/invoice/customer/etc.).

cases.Test Case Title: Notification bell shows correct unread count and 30s poll fallback
cases.Preconditions: New notification created while Socket.io is disconnected (simulate).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Trigger a new notification-worthy event (e.g., job assignment) with sockets disconnected.
2. Wait up to 30 seconds without manual refresh.
cases.Expected Result: Bell unread count updates within ~30 seconds via poll fallback even without an active socket connection.

cases.Test Case Title: Worker dashboard shows assigned work snapshot
cases.Preconditions: Field worker with today/upcoming assigned jobs.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Log in as field worker.
2. Land on '/worker'.
cases.Expected Result: Snapshot of today's/upcoming assigned jobs and relevant counts renders.

cases.Test Case Title: Navigate to jobs/schedule/chat from worker dashboard
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Click 'Jobs' nav, then 'Schedule', then 'Chat'.
cases.Expected Result: Each link routes to the correct worker sub-page.

cases.Test Case Title: Worker jobs list shows only jobs assigned to this worker
cases.Preconditions: Multiple jobs exist; some assigned to this worker, some to others.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Open '/worker/jobs'.
cases.Expected Result: Only jobs assigned to the logged-in worker are listed; no other-company or unassigned jobs appear.

cases.Test Case Title: Worker can filter/search within own jobs
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Use the search/filter control on the worker jobs list.
cases.Expected Result: Filtering narrows results within the worker's own assigned job set only.

cases.Test Case Title: Worker can view full detail of an assigned job
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Open the job from the worker jobs list.
cases.Expected Result: Customer, address, schedule, notes, materials, line items render.

cases.Test Case Title: Worker can only set status to in_progress or completed
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Attempt to change status to 'in_progress'.
2. Then to 'completed'.
3. Attempt to set status to 'cancelled' (should be unavailable to workers).
cases.Expected Result: in_progress and completed transitions succeed; 'cancelled' (and other office-only transitions) are not offered/allowed to the worker role.

cases.Test Case Title: Worker can add notes and attach photos to assigned job
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Add a job note.
2. Attach a photo.
cases.Expected Result: Note and photo persist on the job (subject to the 25 MB file limit).

cases.Test Case Title: Worker accessing an unassigned/other-company job ID gets 404
cases.Preconditions: Job ID assigned to a different worker or belonging to a different company.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Manually navigate to '/worker/jobs/<foreign-id>'.
cases.Expected Result: 404 returned/shown, not 403 and not the job data.

cases.Test Case Title: Worker schedule shows only personal scheduled jobs
cases.Preconditions: Worker has scheduled jobs on a calendar.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Open '/worker/schedule'.
cases.Expected Result: Only this worker's scheduled jobs render on the calendar/list.

cases.Test Case Title: Open job from schedule
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Click a scheduled job entry.
cases.Expected Result: Navigates to the correct '/worker/jobs/:id'.

cases.Test Case Title: Worker views/edits own profile fields
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open profile.
2. Edit phone number.
3. Save.
cases.Expected Result: Changes persist.

cases.Test Case Title: Worker updates notification preferences
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Toggle assignment notification preference.
2. Save.
cases.Expected Result: Preference persists and governs future notification delivery.

cases.Test Case Title: Field worker cannot reach office CRM, billing, or other companies
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Attempt to navigate directly to '/admin', '/admin/settings?tab=billing', and a job/customer URL for another company.
cases.Expected Result: All attempts are blocked (redirect/403/404 as appropriate); no tenant CRM data outside the worker portal is reachable.

cases.Test Case Title: Dashboard shows company counts by status and plan mix
cases.Preconditions: Companies exist in active/trial/suspended states across multiple plans.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Log in as super_admin.
2. Open '/super-admin'.
cases.Expected Result: Counts by status and plan distribution match underlying data; recent platform activity snippets show.

cases.Test Case Title: List companies with name, email, plan, status, employee count
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Open '/super-admin/companies'.
cases.Expected Result: Table shows correct company metadata for every tenant.

cases.Test Case Title: Create company requires inviting a first owner (SA not a tenant member)
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Click 'New company'.
2. Enter company profile and select a plan.
3. Provide the first owner's email to invite.
4. Save.
cases.Expected Result: Company is created; Super Admin is NOT added as a member; an owner-invite email is generated for the given address.

cases.Test Case Title: Edit company profile / plan / status
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open a company row's edit action.
2. Change plan to a higher tier.
3. Change status to 'suspended'.
4. Save.
cases.Expected Result: Plan and status update; a suspended company's tenant users are blocked from CRM login per FR-054.

cases.Test Case Title: Soft-delete a company
cases.Preconditions: Existing company with no critical dependency blocking deletion.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Click 'Delete' on a company.
2. Confirm.
cases.Expected Result: Company is soft-deleted (hidden from active list) but not permanently purged.

cases.Test Case Title: Open company detail from list
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Click a company row.
cases.Expected Result: Navigates to '/super-admin/companies/:id'.

cases.Test Case Title: View company profile, members, billing IDs, status
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Open a company's detail page.
cases.Expected Result: Profile, member list, Stripe billing IDs, and status render correctly.

cases.Test Case Title: Re-invite owner
cases.Preconditions: Company whose original owner invite expired or was never accepted.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Click 'Re-invite owner'.
cases.Expected Result: A new invite email is generated/sent to the owner's address.

cases.Test Case Title: Impersonate owner/admin issues tenant JWT with banner, audited
cases.Preconditions: Company with an active owner/admin member.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Click 'Impersonate' on a member.
2. Observe the impersonation banner in the tenant CRM.
3. Perform a benign read action as the impersonated user.
cases.Expected Result: A tenant-scoped JWT is issued; banner is visible throughout; the impersonation start is recorded in the audit log (actor=super_admin, action=impersonate).

cases.Test Case Title: Stop impersonation restores Super Admin session
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Click 'Stop impersonation' on the banner.
cases.Expected Result: Session reverts to the original Super Admin JWT/session; banner disappears; action audited.

cases.Test Case Title: Client does not silent-refresh during impersonation
cases.Preconditions: Impersonating a tenant user; impersonation token nears expiry.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Remain on an impersonated session until token is close to expiry.
2. Observe client behavior (no automatic refresh).
cases.Expected Result: Unlike normal sessions, the client does not auto-refresh the token during impersonation (FR-018 exception).

cases.Test Case Title: Super Admin cannot use tenant CRM without impersonating
cases.Preconditions: Super Admin logged in, not impersonating.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Attempt to navigate directly to a tenant CRM URL (e.g., '/admin/jobs') as super_admin without impersonation.
cases.Expected Result: Access is blocked/redirected; tenant CRM is only reachable via an active impersonation session.

cases.Test Case Title: List subscription plans
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Open '/super-admin/subscriptions'.
cases.Expected Result: All plans list with key attributes.

cases.Test Case Title: Create/edit plan: pricing, caps, bullets, modules
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Click 'New plan'.
2. Set name, monthly $, yearly $, max workers, max jobs/month.
3. Add marketing bullets.
4. Toggle module checkboxes: reports, calendar, dispatch, inventory.
5. Save.
cases.Expected Result: Plan is created/updated; landing page plan cards (GET /api/plans) reflect it; module toggles gate the corresponding tenant features.

cases.Test Case Title: Stored-only flags (api, white_label, multi_location) have no product behavior
cases.Preconditions: Plan with these flags toggled on.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Enable 'api', 'white_label', 'multi_location' flags on a plan.
2. Log in as a tenant on that plan and look for any resulting UI/API behavior change.
cases.Expected Result: No nav item, feature, or API gate changes as a result — confirms these are stored-only per FR-232/§9 out-of-scope.

cases.Test Case Title: Optional Stripe price ID fields not required for Checkout
cases.Preconditions: New plan without Stripe Price IDs set.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Create a plan leaving Stripe price ID fields blank.
2. As a tenant on that plan, start a Checkout upgrade.
cases.Expected Result: Checkout still works using DB cents (price_data), confirming Price IDs are optional.

cases.Test Case Title: Changing plan dollars applies to new checkouts only
cases.Preconditions: A tenant already subscribed at the old price on a plan.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Change the plan's monthly price in Super Admin.
2. Check the existing subscribed tenant's current billing amount.
3. Have a new tenant subscribe to the same plan.
cases.Expected Result: Existing tenant's current subscription amount is unaffected; the new tenant is billed at the updated price.

cases.Test Case Title: View platform-level reports/aggregates
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Open '/super-admin/reports'.
cases.Expected Result: Platform-wide aggregates render (not scoped to a single tenant).

cases.Test Case Title: List and filter audit events
cases.Preconditions: Prior actions exist (impersonation, plan change, company create, etc.).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open '/super-admin/audit'.
2. Filter by actor, company, or action type.
3. Paginate.
cases.Expected Result: Audit entries (actor, company, action, entity, time) list and filter correctly.

cases.Test Case Title: Sensitive tenant actions are captured in the audit log
cases.Preconditions: Perform a sensitive tenant action (e.g., hard delete, status change, impersonation).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Perform a hard delete of a customer in a tenant (via impersonation).
2. Check '/super-admin/audit' for the corresponding entry.
cases.Expected Result: The action appears in the audit log with correct actor, company, action, and entity.

cases.Test Case Title: Edit trial days and support email
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Change default trial days.
2. Change support email.
3. Save.
cases.Expected Result: Values persist and are used for new signups going forward.

cases.Test Case Title: Configure and save Platform Email SMTP (password encrypted, omitted on GET)
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Enter platform SMTP host, port, user, password, TLS, from name/email, reply-to.
2. Save.
3. Reload the page and inspect the password field.
cases.Expected Result: Config saves (password encrypted at rest); on reload the password field is blank/omitted, never returned by the API.

cases.Test Case Title: Send platform SMTP test email
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Click 'Send test email' on Platform Settings.
cases.Expected Result: Test email sent; evidence/log records channel='platform'.

cases.Test Case Title: Edit platform email templates
cases.Preconditions: Super Admin on Platform Settings > Templates.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Edit the 'welcome' template subject/body.
2. Edit 'payment_failed' template.
3. Save each.
cases.Expected Result: password_reset, welcome, tenant_invitation, system_notification, subscription_started, payment_failed templates are all editable and persist.

cases.Test Case Title: View Stripe configured flag
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Check the Stripe configuration indicator.
cases.Expected Result: Flag accurately reflects whether STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set in the environment.

cases.Test Case Title: Tenants cannot access Platform Settings page or its APIs
cases.Preconditions: Logged in as a tenant office user (owner/admin).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Attempt to navigate directly to '/super-admin/settings'.
2. Attempt to call a platform settings API endpoint directly (e.g., via devtools) if discoverable.
cases.Expected Result: UI route is inaccessible/redirects; API returns 403 on all /api/platform/* routes.

cases.Test Case Title: Super Admin profile view/edit
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open '/super-admin/profile'.
2. Edit name.
3. Save.
cases.Expected Result: Changes persist.

cases.Test Case Title: Super Admin notifications list and mark read
cases.Preconditions: Platform notifications exist (e.g., new company signup, payment failed).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open '/super-admin/notifications'.
2. Mark one/all read.
cases.Expected Result: List renders; read state updates.

cases.Test Case Title: Sidebar/nav only shows role- and permission-filtered links
cases.Preconditions: Users of varying roles/permissions (owner, admin, dispatcher, office, field_worker, super_admin).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Log in as each role in turn.
2. Inspect the visible nav items.
cases.Expected Result: Each role sees only the nav entries their permissions and plan features allow.

cases.Test Case Title: Dark mode toggle applies across the shell
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Toggle dark mode from the layout chrome.
cases.Expected Result: Theme switches and persists during the session.

cases.Test Case Title: Global search (Ctrl+K) aggregates permitted entity types
cases.Preconditions: Office user with a subset of permissions (e.g., no documents.access).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Press Ctrl+K.
2. Search a term matching a customer, a job, and a document name.
cases.Expected Result: Results include customers/jobs (always permitted) but exclude document results since the user lacks documents.access.

cases.Test Case Title: Empty global search shows recently viewed records, no archived leak
cases.Preconditions: User has viewed some records; some customers/jobs are archived.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Press Ctrl+K with an empty query.
cases.Expected Result: Recently viewed records appear; no archived customers/jobs are present in the empty-query result set.

cases.Test Case Title: Notification bell unread count and deep links work across portals
cases.Preconditions: Unread notifications exist for the current user.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open the bell.
2. Click an item's deep link.
cases.Expected Result: Unread count is accurate; deep link navigates to the correct entity.

cases.Test Case Title: Logout revokes refresh token
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Click 'Log out'.
2. Attempt to reuse the old refresh token (e.g., replay via devtools) after logout.
cases.Expected Result: User is returned to '/login'; the previously valid refresh token no longer works.

cases.Test Case Title: Unsaved-change guard fires consistently across dirty forms
cases.Preconditions: Dirty forms across customers, jobs, estimates, workers, inventory, agreements, templates, onboarding.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Make an edit on each listed form without saving.
2. Attempt to navigate away from each.
cases.Expected Result: Every listed form prompts a confirmation before discarding unsaved changes.

cases.Test Case Title: Company id is always derived from JWT, never client body
cases.Preconditions: Two tenants (Company A, Company B) with users logged in.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. As a Company A user, attempt to create/edit a record while tampering with any client-supplied companyId field in the request payload (via devtools) to Company B's id.
cases.Expected Result: The server ignores the client-supplied company id and scopes strictly to the JWT's company_id; the record is created/edited under Company A, not B.

cases.Test Case Title: Requesting another company's resource UUID returns 404, not 403
cases.Preconditions: Company A user; a valid job/customer UUID belonging to Company B.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. As a Company A user, navigate to '/admin/jobs/<company-B-job-id>' directly.
cases.Expected Result: API returns 404 (resource not found), never 403 (which would confirm existence), preventing information leakage.

cases.Test Case Title: RLS FORCE prevents cross-tenant leakage even with app-role queries
cases.Preconditions: Run the provided isolation test suite.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. From backend/, run `npm run test:isolation`.
cases.Expected Result: All isolation tests pass; no cross-tenant rows are ever returned for any RLS-backed table.

cases.Test Case Title: Suspended company blocks tenant CRM login
cases.Preconditions: Company status set to 'suspended' by Super Admin.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Attempt to log in as a member of the suspended company.
cases.Expected Result: Login/tenant middleware blocks access with a suspended/inactive message.

cases.Test Case Title: Expired trial blocks tenant CRM access
cases.Preconditions: Company trial end date has passed with no upgrade.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Attempt to log in / navigate the CRM after trial expiry.
cases.Expected Result: Access is blocked pending upgrade; billing tab remains reachable to resolve it.

cases.Test Case Title: Owner has all tenant permissions including billing and SMTP
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Visit every permission-gated page/tab (billing, SMTP, users, all modules).
cases.Expected Result: Owner can access every tenant-scoped page and action without restriction.

cases.Test Case Title: Admin has all permissions except billing.manage and settings.smtp by default
cases.Preconditions: Logged in as admin (no overrides granted).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Attempt to access Settings > Billing tab.
2. Attempt to access Settings > SMTP tab.
3. Access all other modules.
cases.Expected Result: Billing and SMTP tabs are inaccessible by default; every other module is accessible.

cases.Test Case Title: Dispatcher default permission set matches spec
cases.Preconditions: Logged in as dispatcher (default perms, no overrides).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Attempt to access customers, jobs, dispatch, chat, communications, documents.
2. Attempt to access estimates, invoices, inventory, workers.manage, settings.
cases.Expected Result: First group is accessible (read/write as catalogued); second group is inaccessible by default.

cases.Test Case Title: Office default permission set matches spec
cases.Preconditions: Logged in as office role (default perms).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Attempt to access customers, estimates, invoices, reports, documents, agreements.
2. Attempt to access dispatch, workers.manage, settings.smtp, billing.manage.
cases.Expected Result: First group is accessible; second group is not, by default.

cases.Test Case Title: Field worker default permission set matches spec
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Confirm access to jobs.read (own jobs only), chat.access, communications.access, documents.access.
2. Confirm no access to office-only modules (customers list, invoices, settings, etc.).
cases.Expected Result: Only the specified default permissions are effective; office-only areas are unreachable.

cases.Test Case Title: Owner can override a member's permissions vs role defaults
cases.Preconditions: Owner grants a dispatcher an override to access reports.view.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. As owner, grant the override in Settings > Users.
2. Log in as that dispatcher.
3. Access Reports.
cases.Expected Result: The dispatcher can now access Reports despite it not being in the role's default set.

cases.Test Case Title: Nav and API both require permission AND plan feature for gated modules
cases.Preconditions: Company has 'reports' permission granted to a user but the plan lacks the 'reports' feature.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. As that user, check whether Reports nav item is visible.
2. Attempt direct URL access to '/admin/reports'.
cases.Expected Result: Nav item is hidden and direct access shows Upgrade Required — permission alone is insufficient without the plan feature (and vice versa).

cases.Test Case Title: Platform mail never uses tenant SMTP (no fallback)
cases.Preconditions: Platform SMTP configured; tenant SMTP not configured.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Trigger a platform-channel email (e.g., password reset) for a user in a tenant with no SMTP configured.
cases.Expected Result: Email sends successfully via platform SMTP; the system does not attempt or fall back to tenant SMTP (which isn't configured anyway, proving no cross-channel dependency).

cases.Test Case Title: Tenant CRM mail never falls back to platform SMTP on failure
cases.Preconditions: Tenant SMTP configured with intentionally invalid credentials.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Trigger a tenant-channel email (e.g., send estimate) with broken tenant SMTP credentials.
cases.Expected Result: Send fails with a clear error; the email is NOT silently sent via platform SMTP.

cases.Test Case Title: Sender identity always comes from the stored SMTP config, never client body
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Attempt to override the From/Reply-To address via a tampered request payload when sending a customer email.
cases.Expected Result: The server ignores any client-supplied sender fields and always uses the stored SMTP config's From/Reply-To for that channel.

cases.Test Case Title: All platform-channel email events fire on their triggers
cases.Preconditions: Platform SMTP configured; trigger each event in turn.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Trigger: forgot password, signup/welcome, tenant invitation, staff system notifications (assignment/invoice/etc.), SaaS subscription started, payment failed.
cases.Expected Result: Each event generates the correct platform-channel email with correct template/variables.

cases.Test Case Title: All tenant-channel email events fire on their triggers
cases.Preconditions: Tenant SMTP configured; trigger each event in turn.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Trigger: customer invoice sent, customer estimate sent, job with scheduledDate (appointment), follow-up creation, communication template send.
cases.Expected Result: Each event generates the correct tenant-channel email using tenant SMTP and tenant templates only.

cases.Test Case Title: SMTP passwords never appear in API responses or logs
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Inspect GET responses for company settings and platform settings endpoints via devtools network tab.
2. Inspect server logs if accessible in a test environment.
cases.Expected Result: Password fields are omitted/redacted in all API responses and never appear in plaintext logs.

cases.Test Case Title: Passwords are hashed with Argon2 (not reversible/plaintext)
cases.Preconditions: Test/staging DB access available to QA.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Create a user via signup.
2. Inspect the stored password hash in the users table.
cases.Expected Result: Stored value is an Argon2 hash, never plaintext or reversibly encrypted.

cases.Test Case Title: Invite/reset/refresh tokens are stored hashed (SHA-256)
cases.Preconditions: Generate an invite and a password-reset token.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Inspect the corresponding DB rows for these tokens.
cases.Expected Result: Only SHA-256 hashes of the tokens are stored, not the raw token values.

cases.Test Case Title: Auth endpoints are rate-limited in production (100 req/15 min)
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Send 101+ rapid login attempts from the same client within 15 minutes.
cases.Expected Result: Requests beyond the limit are rejected with a rate-limit error (e.g., 429).

cases.Test Case Title: Access JWT expires after 15 minutes; refresh token lasts 14 days
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Inspect the JWT expiry claim after login.
2. Leave the session idle beyond 15 minutes and perform an action (auto-refresh should occur).
cases.Expected Result: Access token exp is 15 minutes from issuance; the client transparently refreshes using the refresh token (valid 14 days) except during impersonation.

cases.Test Case Title: Production build rejects placeholder secrets / default encryption key / hardcoded DB password
cases.Preconditions: Attempt to deploy/run in production mode with a placeholder JWT secret, default SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY, or the dev fieldpro_app password.
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Start the server in production mode with one of these unsafe defaults present.
2. Observe startup behavior.
cases.Expected Result: The system refuses to start (or clearly errors) rather than silently running with insecure defaults.

cases.Test Case Title: Helmet security headers are present on responses
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API): 1. Inspect response headers for a typical API call via devtools/network tab.
cases.Expected Result: Standard Helmet-provided security headers (e.g., X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options / CSP as configured) are present.

cases.Test Case Title: Stripe webhook processing is idempotent by stripe_event_id
cases.Preconditions: A Stripe test event is deliverable twice (simulate retry).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Send the same Stripe webhook event twice (same event id).
2. Check resulting company status / billing records.
cases.Expected Result: The second delivery is a no-op; no duplicate state changes or billing records occur.

cases.Test Case Title: Local file storage confirms FILE_DRIVER=local behavior
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Upload a file.
2. Verify its storage path on disk under uploads/{company_id}/.
cases.Expected Result: File is stored on local disk exactly under the expected per-company path.

cases.Test Case Title: SMTP send failures surface a clean error without leaking stack traces/secrets
cases.Preconditions: Force an SMTP send failure (bad credentials).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Trigger a tenant email send with intentionally broken SMTP creds.
2. Inspect the UI error and any exposed response body.
cases.Expected Result: A clear, user-facing error is shown; no stack trace or secret values are exposed; the underlying business record (e.g., invoice) is not corrupted.

cases.Test Case Title: List toolbars keep primary filters visible with secondary behind 'More'
cases.Preconditions: Any list page with several filters (jobs/customers/estimates).
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open a list page.
2. Observe toolbar layout.
cases.Expected Result: Primary search/filters are always visible; secondary filters are tucked behind a 'More' control; saved views sit in a compact menu.

cases.Test Case Title: List endpoints paginate with default 25 / max 100 page size
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Load a list with no explicit page size (expect default 25).
2. Request page size = 100.
3. Attempt to request page size > 100 (e.g., 500).
cases.Expected Result: Default returns 25 rows; 100 is honored; a request above 100 is capped at 100 rather than honored as-is.

cases.Test Case Title: Dropdown/related-record caches load up to 100 active records (known limitation)
cases.Test Steps (via UI → triggers API):
1. Open a job-create form's customer dropdown.
2. Search for a customer beyond the first 100 by creation order, without typing a matching search term.
cases.Expected Result: Dropdown may not show that customer without an explicit search match — documented as a known limitation (should-improve).
